account.dangerNote: Only use this if you really want to remove this account.
account.deleteFlowBody: This starts the account deletion flow and may transfer {{symbol}} out of accessible wallets before the deletion request is submitted.
account.dangerBody: Delete your account and log out. Your account stays recoverable for 30 days, but any {{symbol}} in your accessible wallets will be transferred out before the deletion request is submitted.

w9.supportBody: The name and taxpayer number on your W-9 still didn't match IRS records. Please use Contact SFLuv in Settings and we'll help sort it out.
w9.correctionBody: The name or taxpayer number on your W-9 didn't match IRS records. Check your number digit by digit, and use your name exactly as it appears on your Social Security card.
w9.correctionEmphasis: You'll get a fresh, blank form.
w9.adminTitle: SFLuv has asked you for a W-9
w9.adminBody: We need a W-9 on file for you. It takes a couple of minutes, and the form is hosted securely by our tax provider.
w9.adminBodyYear: We need a W-9 on file for you for {{year}}. It takes a couple of minutes, and the form is hosted securely by our tax provider.
w9.noticeTitle: You're on your way to a tax form
w9.noticeBody: Once you've earned {{threshold}} {{symbol}} in a year, we need a W-9 on file before we can send you any more.
w9.pastLimitTitle: We need a W-9 from you
w9.pastLimitBody: You're past {{threshold}} {{symbol}} for the year, so we need a W-9 on file. It takes a couple of minutes.
w9.warningBody: We'll need a W-9 on file before we can send anything past {{threshold}} {{symbol}}. It takes a couple of minutes.
w9.warningEmphasis: Do it now and your rewards keep arriving without interruption.
w9.escrowBody: You've reached {{threshold}} {{symbol}} for the year, so we're holding this reward until your W-9 is on file.
w9.escrowEmphasis: The money is yours. Complete the form and we'll send it straight over.
w9.blockedTitle: We can't send your rewards yet
w9.blockedBody: You have earned more than {{threshold}} {{symbol}} this year already. Please fill out a W-9 here.
w9.blockedEmphasis: Your QR code is still good — scan it again once the form is in.
w9.opensOutside: Opens the secure tax form outside the app.
w9.completeReleased: has been released from hold and sent to your wallet.
w9.completeBodyReleased: Nothing is being held any more, and future rewards will arrive as normal. We'll let you know if the IRS check finds anything to fix.
w9.completeBody: Nothing is being held, and your rewards will arrive as normal. We'll let you know if the IRS check finds anything to fix.
w9.cardTitle: Complete your W-9 to get paid
w9.cardBody: You've earned over {{threshold}} SFLUV this year, so we need a W-9 on file before we can send it. It takes a couple of minutes.

wallet.noPaymentsBody: Your latest sends and receives will appear here after the first transfer.

login.differentEmail: Use a different email or sign-in option
